                   abs(a['regression_ratio'] - b['regression_ratio']) +
                   abs(a['lifecycle_deviation_ratio'] - b['lifecycle_deviation_ratio']) +
                   abs(a['total_lifecycle_days'] - b['total_lifecycle_days']))
        sample_pairs.append((a['issue_id'], b['issue_id'], distance))

sample_df = pd.DataFrame(sample_pairs, columns=['issue_id_a', 'issue_id_b', 'distance'])
median_distance = sample_df['distance'].median()
print(f"Median distance from sample: {median_distance:.4f}")

# Second pass: Process full dataset in chunks
for chunk_idx in tqdm(range(num_chunks), desc="Processing chunks"):

                   lifecycle_deviation_ratio,
                   total_lifecycle_days
            FROM jira__issue_intelligence_analytics
            LIMIT {chunk_size}
            OFFSET {start_idx}
        ) AS subquery;
    """, conn)
